clues.text: In his first year, this king of Persia proclaimed that God's people could go up and rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.
This king had his treasurer Mithredath count out the temple articles Nebuchadnezzar took and hand them to Sheshbazzar.
Through Isaiah, the LORD called this ruler His shepherd, who would see Jerusalem rebuilt and the temple's foundation laid.
Through Isaiah, God called this foreign king His anointed, whose right hand He grasped to subdue nations.
When Darius ordered a search, a scroll in Ecbatana showed this king had decreed the temple's costs be paid from the royal treasury.
After God rescued Daniel from the lions, Daniel prospered during the reigns of Darius and this Persian king.
Returned exiles paid the people of Sidon and Tyre to ship cedar logs from Lebanon to Joppa, as this king authorized.
